series.name: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE
series.description: 10-episode AI-generated historical reenactment series covering major World War II battlefields from 1939 to 1945 with archival-style visuals and a physically embedded human wartime cameraman.
series.workflow: PRO V6.8 P&P Movie Studio STEP6
series.audioPolicy: No dialogue, no narrator and no music. Diegetic battlefield ambience, weather, vehicles, footsteps, equipment, gunfire, artillery and nonverbal breathing only.
series.visualPolicy: AI-generated reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm wartime newsreel. Period-correct uniforms and equipment, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no triumphalist staging.

forbidden: camera teleporting ahead of the action
camera staying impossibly exposed while troops hide
camera passing through walls, soldiers or vehicles

archivalLook.disclosure: AI-generated historical reenactment with archival-style treatment. Not genuine archival footage.
